name: Betriebsgebäude II / Verwaltung (Siemensbau)

references.use: LRZ identifies TUM 5103 as Betriebsgebäude II (Siemensbau), Boltzmannstr. 10.
TUM building identity and single ground-floor record.

localObservation.note: Private provider imagery was inspected locally; no provider image or mesh is included in this reference. The north-facing window/entrance rhythm is visible over roughly the first 42 m. The remaining north wall is largely occluded by adjacent BVV DEBY_LOD2_5284446. The southern scan is severely incomplete. End elevations have blurry observations. Fine opening sizes, colours and divisions are estimates.

neighbours.telefonzentrale: DEBY_LOD2_8486669 joins the west via a short passage. Its four-window west photograph is not a reference for Siemensbau.
neighbours.northEast: DEBY_LOD2_5284446 approaches within about 1.436 m. Do not retire its mesh.

qualification: A source-informed exterior reconstruction, not an as-built model. Unobserved openings on the south and occluded north are provisional continuations of the observed office-window rhythm. No interiors.
